Our History

Founded and managed by Mr. Mahesh Jetha, Jetha Kitchen Equipments & Designings is a premier manufacturer, supplier, and trader of robust commercial kitchen equipment based in Udaipur, Rajasthan. We specialize in complete turnkey kitchen setups, custom-branded LED display counters, heavy-duty commercial gas ranges, and high-capacity stainless steel water coolers.

Infrastructure

We operate out of a well-equipped manufacturing facility located in the Gudli Industrial Area, Udaipur, outfitted with sheet-metal fabrication, laser-cut LED panel work, refrigeration assembly, and stainless steel finishing capabilities. Client consultations and corporate operations are handled at our office located Opposite Dalal Petrol Pump, B N College Road, Sevashram Road, Udaipur (313001).

Our Mission

To deliver stainless steel excellence across every culinary setup—from bakeries, sweet shops, and street-food kiosks to hotels, restaurants, schools, and large catering operations. Every product is built for durability, hygiene, and visual appeal, backed by competitive factory-direct pricing and reliable delivery.
